business_scenario: An unauthenticated visitor to the public /search endpoint could read the users table of the production shop: customer names, emails and password hashes.
rationale: Hits the critical-tier shop-api asset (production, internet-exposed); the vulnerable query runs against the same database that stores customer PII and credentials, so impact on this organization is above the generic CVSS reading.
assumptions: Production database contains real customer records (owner-stated in business_context)
